description: Source code for auction lot numbering wizard in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form definitions, methods for record reading, existence testing, and numbering logic, as well as wizard state transitions.

classes.name: wiz_auc_lots_numerotate
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing the auction lot numbering process with multiple states.

methods.name: _read_record
methods.description: Reads auction lot record details based on form input, raises error if not found.

methods.name: _test_exist
methods.description: Checks if a specific auction lot exists based on form input.

methods.name: _numerotate
methods.description: Assigns a specific number to selected auction lots.

methods.name: _numerotate_cont
methods.description: Assigns sequential numbers to auction lots starting from a given number.
